Container.Name: ffbe
Container.Overview: Exvius Offline game server for the iPhone app, with Tailscale in the same container (it joins your tailnet as "ffbe"; no ports are opened on the server). The image is built locally from the repository: docker compose build in /mnt/user/appdata/ffbe/repo/ios-server.

Config.Name: Game data
Config.Description: Game data packs (about 15 GB). Re-downloadable with fetch-data.

Config.Name: Server folder
Config.Description: Your save, certificates, request logs and client reports.

Config.Name: Tailscale state
Config.Description: Keeps this container signed in to your tailnet as "ffbe".

Config.Name: Tunnel device
Config.Description: Tailscale runs inside the container and needs the tunnel device.

Config.Name: TS_AUTHKEY
Config.Description: Only needed the first time; leave empty once the Tailscale state folder has signed in as "ffbe".

Config.Name: FFBE_REQUEST_LOG_DAYS
Config.Description: Request records older than this many days are deleted (checked hourly).

Config.Name: FFBE_REQUEST_LOG_MB
Config.Description: Request records are trimmed, oldest first, to stay under this many MB.

Config.Name: FFBE_CLIENT_REPORTS_KEEP
Config.Description: How many of the game's uploaded logs (client-reports) to keep, newest first.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_CLIENT_REPORTS
Config.Description: 1 asks the game to upload its own error log (client-reports) for troubleshooting, once per launch (tens of MB each). Leave 0 otherwise.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_SUMMON_ROTATION
Config.Description: Weekly summon rotation (see source/server/gacha_rotation.py). Set to 0 to show every banner at once; that also turns the historic replay off.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ROTATION_DAY
Config.Description: 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ROTATION_HOUR
Config.Description: 10 PM

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ROTATION_SPECIAL
Config.Description: sets with step-up / ticket / select banners each week

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ROTATION_FEATURED
Config.Description: other featured sets each week

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ROTATION_FIRST_WEEK
Config.Description: Without the replay: your first week opens with Noctis's Dec 2016 banner; later weeks are random.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ROTATION_HOLIDAYS
Config.Description: Holiday sets (Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's, Easter) only in the week before the holiday and the holiday's own week, oldest first.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_REPLAY
Config.Description: Historical replay (source/server/replay.py): summons, Vortex and shops follow Global's own history, starting at EXVIUS_REPLAY_START and moving EXVIUS_REPLAY_PACE historical weeks per real week. Permanent summons only draw units released by then. "0" goes back to the random weekly rotation. Delete server/state/replay.json to restart the replay from EXVIUS_REPLAY_START.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_REPLAY_FULL_RUNS
Config.Description: With the replay on, a banner or event stays up for every week its whole Global run overlaps. 0 = one week per start date.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_REPLAY_PACE
Config.Description: 3 weeks per week, then 2 from the first Neo Vision banner

Config.Name: EXVIUS_REPLAY_NOTICES
Config.Description: A "This week" notice on the News board for each replay week ("0" turns them off).

Config.Name: EXVIUS_REPLAY_MARQUEE
Config.Description: Home screen banners: this replay week's event banners (the original art, same as the Vortex tiles). MARQUEE_FLAG turns the home banner strip on; set it to "0" if the home screen misbehaves.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_VORTEX_ROTATION
Config.Description: The Vortex follows the summons: permanent dungeons, the events that launched with this week's sets, and EXVIUS_VORTEX_EXTRA undated recurring events. "0" opens every archived event at once.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_EARLY_RESOURCES
Config.Description: Resource packs downloaded before the tutorial (the first battle needs them). "all" or "0" also work.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_IOS_HCA_PLAIN
Config.Description: Sound banks for the iPhone: "1" removes the Android banks' HCA cipher, "0" serves them as shipped.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_IOS_SOUND_REFETCH
Config.Description: Change this to any new value to make the phone download every sound bank again.

Config.Name: ANNIVERSARY_TICKET
Config.Description: "1" mails a free 8th-Anniversary 10+1 summon ticket every day; "0" turns it off.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_PLAYERS
Config.Description: Other players (source/server/friend_players.py): made-up accounts you can add, borrow units from and remove. Each lends a different unit every week. EXVIUS_START_FRIENDS of them are your friends in a new save. "0" players turns the crowd off.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_ARENA_TOP
Config.Description: Arena (source/server/arena_ladder.py): the other players' teams and a weekly leaderboard. The best of them ends the week near EXVIUS_ARENA_TOP points; your final rank pays that week's ranking reward.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_LAPIS_MULTIPLIER
Config.Description: every Lapis amount earned by playing Earned Lapis (source/server/lapis_economy.py). Shop purchases are never multiplied.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_DAILY_QUEST_LAPIS
Config.Description: Lapis per daily quest (0 = the old gil/Lapis mix)

Config.Name: EXVIUS_DAILY_ALL_BONUS
Config.Description: extra Lapis for finishing all of a day's dailies

Config.Name: EXVIUS_DAILY_CUSTOM
Config.Description: Custom daily quests with varying rewards (source/server/daily_quests_custom.json). 0 = only the original daily quests.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_DAILY_QUEST_COUNT
Config.Description: Daily quests a day while the custom ones are on.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_WEEKLY_GIFT
Config.Description: mailed each week: 10 Rare Summon Tickets + a Guaranteed Ticket; "" = off

Config.Name: EXVIUS_FIRST_CLEAR
Config.Description: Pay each quest's first-clear reward once (source/server/first_clear.py). 0 = off.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_FIRST_CLEAR_BACKPAY
Config.Description: One mail (sent once) with the first-clear rewards of quests cleared before EXVIUS_FIRST_CLEAR existed. 0 = off.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_EVENT_CURRENCY_RUNS
Config.Description: Event currency drops from the event's enemies at Global's amounts, multiplied so the event's gear, materia, units and tickets take about this many clears of its top quest (source/server/global_drops.py). 0 = Global's own amounts.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_WIKI_DROP_RATE
Config.Description: Percent chance for each enemy drop that only the FFBE wiki lists (Global's record), added to Japan's drop lists (source/server/global_drops.py). 0 leaves them out.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_QUEST_TRUST
Config.Description: Trust from clearing quests (source/server/quest_trust.py). 0 = off.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_QUEST_TRUST_CHANCE
Config.Description: Percent chance per party unit per clear. Japan 30 (default), Global 10.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_QUEST_TRUST_POINTS
Config.Description: Trust per hit in tenths of a percent (1 = 0.1%, 10 = 1%). Japan 10 (default), Global 1.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_QUEST_TRUST_BIG_CHANCE
Config.Description: Percent of trust hits that give EXVIUS_QUEST_TRUST_BIG_POINTS instead. 0 = none.

Config.Name: EXVIUS_QUEST_TRUST_BIG_POINTS
Config.Description: Trust on a big hit, in tenths of a percent (50 = 5%).

Config.Name: EXVIUS_LAPIS_SHOP_EXCLUDE
Config.Description: Products kept out of the exchange shops that sell for Lapis (kind:id). Default: King Metal Minituar.
